limitations: Checkpoint payloads are SHA-verified; no tensor reload or new neural forward is performed. Activation identity relies on producer metadata bound to these checkpoints and data, plus current payload SHA.

Existing standardized copies are compared with their completed prior-probe receipts. Newly needed validation action0 is compared exactly with existing copies; actions1/2 are read directly from hash-verified source caches.
Historical CPU-extracted pilot values can differ numerically from saved cached features even with identical checkpoint/data/point; calibration must use a prespecified numerical tolerance.
